source: This is why “ZXNAME0000XZ makes attention linear” is wrong. If a system shows near-linear scaling because it uses a local window or another sparse pattern, the sparsity is what changed the number of interactions. ZXNAME0001XZ may still be the kernel underneath.
zh: 这就是为什么“ZXNAME0000XZ 使注意力呈线性”是错误的。如果系统由于使用局部窗口或其他稀疏模式而显示出近线性缩放，则稀疏性会改变交互数量。 ZXNAME0001XZ 可能仍然是底层的内核。
